resources.string: Mark the first sound and last sound of each line. LRC timestamps mean line START. Ends clear the line during gaps. The original changes only when you save.
Keep start before end, within the song, and avoid overlapping the next line.
Play this song first, then mark its playback position.
Could not save. The original or song may have changed. Your draft is kept.
Lyrics saved. Manually recorded or corrected timing is used for learning.
Learning from reviewed lyrics before trying again.
More reviewed timing is needed. A new validated model can propose again; the rejected result will not be repeated.
A new lyric timing proposal is queued.
A new proposal is ready. Tap ✨ to review.
Timing model validated on separate recordings.
The candidate did not pass validation. Keeping the previous timing model.
Not enough separate recordings for validation. General timing stays conservative.
Recording cross-validation · the tested recording and its copies are excluded from learning.
Automatic retry paused. Tap ✨ to request another analysis.
Learning could not finish. Your corrections are kept; retry from Algorithm management.
